edits.old: Then a case in any other status has no open decision task
edits.new:
Then a case in any other status has no open decision task

  Scenario: AC20 Activity retry and timeout (BR12)
    Given an activity call to the case database is retried or times out
    When the activity retries
    Then the retry follows the outbox policy of RWB-PLT-TE006-CON
    Then the event is applied once and the case and its task are written together or not at all

  Scenario: AC21 Consumed call fails or does not answer (BR12)
    Given the rwb-decision contract call fails or does not answer for an approval decided event
    When the router runs for the approval
    Then the case status is not changed and no decision task is written
    Then the event stays on the topic for redelivery
